commits.subject: fix(reconcile): handle picks with null game_pk
commits.body:
Pre-scheduler picks (Mar 29-30) have game_pk: null, which caused
check_hit to request .../game/None/feed/live — an HTTP 400. Now
skips the direct lookup when game_pk is None and falls through to
the date-based schedule search.
